scientific_integrity: The theorem follows from explicit normal-subgroup classification and quotient-embedding analysis. Finite verification only corroborates selected parameters.
scientific_limitations: Cyclic-kernel dicyclic groups of order \(4m\) with \(m\ge2\) only; no classification of arbitrary generalized dicyclic groups.
Exhaustive direct checks cover \(2\le m\le12\) only; the complete theorem relies on its symbolic proof.
No historical priority claim beyond the inspected literature; independent audit is not performed.
title: Two divisor branches and a sharp meet defect in dicyclic quotient-isomorphism posets
